description: Core API models for admin panel (auth, book, user, category, analytics). Defines data structures and serialization logic for various entities within the admin panel backend, including authentication tokens, user info, book and category models, pagination, and analytical summaries.

classes.name: AuthTokens
classes.description: Represents authentication tokens with JSON serialization/deserialization methods.

classes.name: AdminUser
classes.description: Models an administrator user with identifying and status information, supports JSON serialization.

classes.name: BookModel
classes.description: Represents a book entity with related details including categories, supports JSON serialization.

classes.name: CategorySummary
classes.description: Lightweight category info, typically used in listings or summaries, supports JSON deserialization.

classes.name: CategoryModel
classes.description: Full category details, supports JSON deserialization.

classes.name: PageMeta
classes.description: Metadata for paginated responses, supports JSON deserialization.

classes.name: AnalyticsSummary
classes.description: Aggregated statistics for analytics, supports JSON deserialization.
